description: This Java source file defines the CheckInAndDeleteDataItemsService class, an Android IntentService responsible for handling check-in actions and the deletion of data items in a geofencing app that uses Wearable APIs. It manages GoogleApiClient connections, performs data deletion, and displays confirmation animations on the wearable device.

classes.name: CheckInAndDeleteDataItemsService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles 'Check In' actions and deletion of orphaned DataItems in a wearable geofencing application. It manages GoogleApiClient lifecycle, processes intents based on actions, performs data deletion via Wearable DataApi, and shows confirmation animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and sets connection callbacks.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to perform check-in confirmation or delete data items. Manages GoogleApiClient connection, performs data deletion, and logs outcomes.

methods.name: startConfirmationActivity
methods.description: Creates and starts a confirmation animation activity on the wearable device with specified animation type and message.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient connects successfully (currently empty).

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient connection is suspended (currently empty).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient fails to connect (currently empty).
